note: Spider 1.0 dev, stratified sample by official hardness: 300 of 1034 proportional within each level, random.Random(2026). id is the question's index in dev.json. Built by experiments/build_spider_eval.py.

questions.question: For each continent, list its id, name, and how many countries it has?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.ContId ,  T1.Continent ,  count(*) FROM CONTINENTS AS T1 JOIN COUNTRIES AS T2 ON T1.ContId  =  T2.Continent GROUP BY T1.ContId;

questions.question: What is the full name of each car maker, along with its id and how many models it produces?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.FullName ,  T1.Id ,  count(*) FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.Maker GROUP BY T1.Id;

questions.question: Which distinct car models are the produced after 1980?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.model FROM MODEL_LIST AS T1 JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T2 ON T1.model  =  T2.model JOIN CARS_DATA AS T3 ON T2.MakeId  =  T3.id WHERE T3.year  >  1980;

questions.question: Which of the countries has the most car makers? List the country name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.CountryName FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN COUNTRIES AS T2 ON T1.Country  =  T2.CountryId GROUP BY T1.Country ORDER BY Count(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: How many car models are produced by each maker ? Only list the count and the maker full name .
questions.gold_sql: select count(*) ,  t2.fullname from model_list as t1 join car_makers as t2 on t1.maker  =  t2.id group by t2.id;

questions.question: What is the accelerate of the car make amc hornet sportabout (sw)?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Accelerate FROM CARS_DATA AS T1 JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.MakeId WHERE T2.Make  =  'amc hornet sportabout (sw)';

questions.question: How many car models are produced in the usa?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM MODEL_LIST AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.Maker  =  T2.Id JOIN COUNTRIES AS T3 ON T2.Country  =  T3.CountryId WHERE T3.CountryName  =  'usa';

questions.question: What are the makers and models?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Maker ,  Model FROM MODEL_LIST;

questions.question: What are the names and ids of all countries with at least one car maker?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.CountryName ,  T1.CountryId FROM COUNTRIES AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.CountryId  =  T2.Country GROUP BY T1.CountryId HAVING count(*)  >=  1;

questions.question: What is the average weight of cars each year?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(Weight) ,  YEAR FROM CARS_DATA GROUP BY YEAR;

questions.question: What is the maximum horsepower and the make of the car models with 3 cylinders?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.horsepower ,  T1.Make FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.MakeId  =  T2.Id WHERE T2.cylinders  =  3 ORDER BY T2.horsepower DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Which model saves the most gasoline? That is to say, have the maximum miles per gallon.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.MakeId  =  T2.Id ORDER BY T2.mpg DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: What is the maximum accelerate for different number of cylinders?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT max(Accelerate) ,  Cylinders FROM CARS_DATA GROUP BY Cylinders;

questions.question: What is the number of cars with more than 4 cylinders?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM CARS_DATA WHERE Cylinders  >  4;

questions.question: how many cars were produced in 1980?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM CARS_DATA WHERE YEAR  =  1980;

questions.question: What is the number of car models created by the car maker American Motor Company?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM CAR_MAKERS AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.Maker WHERE T1.FullName  =  'American Motor Company';

questions.question: What are the different models created by either the car maker General Motors or weighed more than 3500?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Model  =  T2.Model JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T2.Maker  =  T3.Id JOIN CARS_DATA AS T4 ON T1.MakeId  =  T4.Id WHERE T3.FullName  =  'General Motors' OR T4.weight  >  3500;

questions.question: In which years cars were produced weighing no less than 3000 and no more than 4000 ?
questions.gold_sql: select distinct year from cars_data where weight between 3000 and 4000;

questions.question: What are the different years in which there were cars produced that weighed less than 4000 and also cars that weighted more than 3000 ?
questions.gold_sql: select distinct year from cars_data where weight between 3000 and 4000;

questions.question: What is the horsepower of the car with the largest accelerate?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.horsepower FROM CARS_DATA AS T1 ORDER BY T1.accelerate DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: For a volvo model, how many cylinders does the version with least accelerate have?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.cylinders FROM CARS_DATA AS T1 JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T2 ON T1.Id  =  T2.MakeId WHERE T2.Model  =  'volvo' ORDER BY T1.accelerate ASC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: How many cars have a larger accelerate than the car with the largest horsepower?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CARS_DATA WHERE Accelerate  >  ( SELECT Accelerate FROM CARS_DATA ORDER BY Horsepower DESC LIMIT 1 );

questions.question: How many countries has more than 2 car makers ?
questions.gold_sql: select count(*) from countries as t1 join car_makers as t2 on t1.countryid  =  t2.country group by t1.countryid having count(*)  >  2

questions.question: What is the number of carsw ith over 6 cylinders?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CARS_DATA WHERE Cylinders  >  6;

questions.question: For the cars with 4 cylinders, which model has the largest horsepower?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.MakeId  =  T2.Id WHERE T2.Cylinders  =  4 ORDER BY T2.horsepower DESC LIMIT 1;

questions.question: Among the cars that do not have the minimum horsepower , what are the make ids and names of all those with less than 4 cylinders ?
questions.gold_sql: select t2.makeid ,  t2.make from cars_data as t1 join car_names as t2 on t1.id  =  t2.makeid where t1.horsepower  >  (select min(horsepower) from cars_data) and t1.cylinders  <  4;

questions.question: What is the maximum miles per gallon of the car with 8 cylinders or produced before 1980 ?
questions.gold_sql: select max(mpg) from cars_data where cylinders  =  8 or year  <  1980

questions.question: What are the different models wthat are lighter than 3500 but were not built by the Ford Motor Company?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.model FROM MODEL_LIST AS T1 JOIN CAR_NAMES AS T2 ON T1.Model  =  T2.Model JOIN CARS_DATA AS T3 ON T2.MakeId  =  T3.Id JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T4 ON T1.Maker  =  T4.Id WHERE T3.weight  <  3500 AND T4.FullName != 'Ford Motor Company';

questions.question: What are the name of the countries where there is not a single car maker?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT CountryName FROM countries EXCEPT SELECT T1.CountryName FROM countries AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.countryId  =  T2.Country;

questions.question: What are the names of the countries with no car makers?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT CountryName FROM countries EXCEPT SELECT T1.CountryName FROM countries AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.countryId  =  T2.Country;
